Rune Labs | Remote (US, CA) | Full Time | Senior or Lead Backend Engineer

Rune Labs is a precision neurology startup focused on helping people with Parkinson's. We built StrivePD, an app to help them manage their disease. It's used by individuals, pharma companies running trials, and health systems.

We're looking for a Senior or Lead Backend Developer. We're a small team, so will have the opportunity to work on a bit of everything.

Apply here: https://forms.gle/N57yNv7qgKJrmAVs6
